name: Savitribai Phule Scholarship For V.J.N.T And S.B.C Girls Students Studying In 8th To 10 Std
benefit: The beneficiary is to provide ₹100/- per month for 10 months i.e. ₹1,000/- for 10 months.
_eligibility_text:
1. Girl Student should belong to V.J.N.T. or S.B.C category.
1. Girl Student should be studying in 8th to 10th Standard.
1. No income limit and there will be no limit of marks.
